prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Official Companion Adoption", "Sign below to officially welcome your new desktop companion.", "Companion Name"]
1: ["Verifying Desktop Workspace", "Ensuring pet display permissions and screen placement are active.", "Launch Desktop Pet"]
2: ["Choose Your Pet Journey", "Select how you would like to create your new companion."]
3: ["Upload & Verify Pet Photo", "Preview how your custom pet will look before completing adoption.", "Select Photo"]
4: ["Signing in with your existing account automatically restores your saved pets and progress."]
5: ["Creating Your Desktop Pet", "Your companion is being built and prepared for desktop launch.", "Estimated completion time: 2 minutes."]
6: ["Each path determines companion traits and how your pet interacts on your desktop."]
7: ["Welcome Your Companion!", "Learn how to summon, control, and interact with your pet on your desktop.", "Tray Icon: Right-click to hide or summon\nShortcut: Cmd/Ctrl+Pet to talk\nSettings: Custom behaviors"]
8: ["Preparing Desktop Pet", "You can safely minimize this window while we finish rendering.", "We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready."]
9: ["Quick Sign-In", "Sign in to save your companion across all your desktop devices."]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information by requiring the user to sign.
